summary_en: FY9/26 full-year dividend raised to ¥6.72/share from ¥5.21/share (+¥1.51, +29%). Payout ratio 29% of consolidated attributable net income (¥2,500M, up 31.6% YoY). Dividend policy targets 30% payout ratio with adjustment for non-recurring items.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast (Upward Revision) and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending September 2026
translation_en_brief: LIFULL revised its FY9/26 dividend forecast upward on 12 August 2026. The full-year dividend per share is raised to ¥6.72 from the prior forecast of ¥5.21 (an increase of ¥1.51 or 29%). This revision follows an upward revision to consolidated attributable net income to ¥2,500M (from ¥1,900M, +31.6%), driven by stronger-than-expected performance in the HOME'S real-estate information business and cost savings from in-house AI adoption and group synergies. The company maintains its baseline dividend policy of targeting a 30% payout ratio, with adjustments for non-recurring items. The revised payout ratio for FY9/26 is approximately 29%.
